description: Synthetic cross-platform game catalog, friend libraries, shelves, polls, and 640x360 illustrated PNG gameplay/HUD preview screenshots for QuestShelf. Full 2025-01-01..2026-12-31 synthetic evaluation dataset is delivered alongside in datasets/eval-2025-2026/seed.json (metadata in datasets/eval-2025-2026/dataset.json).

sources.description: 100% synthetic fictional cross-platform game metadata, shelf logs, friend libraries, and poll fixtures (fixtures/minimal.json, fixtures/seed-casual.json, and datasets/eval-2025-2026/seed.json via scripts/build-eval-dataset.cjs).
Programmatically rendered 640x360 PNG gameplay & proportional HUD preview screenshots via scripts/render-previews.py (Pillow), with zero text-caption spoilers.

transformations: Normalized ISO timestamps, verified SHA-256 digests, quantized 20 PNGs to 117.5 KiB (<= 1 MiB bundle budget), neutralized all game summaries and asset alt_text.

review.notes: All 20 regenerated 640x360 PNGs and the 2025-2026 evaluation dataset are author-checked; independent reviewer/maintainer sign-off pending.
